AI Development Instructions
This application uses Vue 3, Vite, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Coding Standards
Use Vue 3 Composition API with <script setup> syntax.
Use JavaScript instead of TypeScript.
Keep code beginner-friendly and easy to understand.
Add comments only when they help explain important logic.
Use descriptive variable and function names.
Existing Functionality
Preserve existing functionality when making changes.
Do not remove features unless specifically requested.
Make changes incrementally and avoid unnecessary refactoring.
Verify that new code does not break existing components.
Dependencies
Avoid adding new libraries or dependencies unless necessary.
Prefer built-in Vue and JavaScript features when possible.
Explain why any new dependency is needed before using it.
Add more questions to the quiz to increase its educational value.
Randomize the order of questions and answer choices to enhance replayability.
User Interface
Keep the interface clean and responsive.
Use consistent styling throughout the application.
Ensure pages work on desktop and mobile devices.
Prioritize readability over complex designs.
AI Assistant Expectations
Explain any significant code changes.
Provide step-by-step instructions when setup is required.
Show complete code examples when modifying files.
Identify potential errors or improvements.
Run npm run build to verify that changes compile successfully.
